persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a realistic, silent 15-second widescreen story in three shots: a woman with a freckled face and red pixie cut drops a red scarf; a man with a shaved head and round glasses picks it up; he returns it and they smile. Both adults, on a quiet street. Show both faces clearly in every shot and keep exactly the same two faces throughout—no changing actors between cuts.
bank.Character identities: An adult woman with a freckled face and red pixie cut, and an adult man with a shaved head and round glasses. Invent their faces but keep each identity unchanged across all three shots.
bank.Face visibility: Both faces must be clearly visible in every shot, including when the scarf is dropped and picked up.
bank.Story and setting: On a quiet street, the woman drops a red scarf, the man picks it up, and he returns it before they smile at each other.
bank.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video in three shots.
bank.Style and mood: Realistic live action, a small friendly encounter.
bank.Sound and text: Silent, with no captions, titles or dialogue.

messages.text: Could you make a realistic, silent story in three shots about a small encounter on a quiet street, with both people being adults? I like these little moments of kindness because they remind me of how much a brief interaction can mean. The woman has a freckled face and a red pixie cut, and she drops a red scarf in the first shot. The whole thing should be a 15-second widescreen video, and in the second shot a man with a shaved head and round glasses picks the scarf up. In the third shot, he returns it to her and they smile. My main worry is that the people might look like different actors after a cut. Please show both faces clearly in every shot and keep exactly the same two faces throughout, with no changing actors between cuts.
